body: REF. 13 SEARCH, at the Admiral's request (09:3x). Ref. 13 of the 1969 paper is Budiansky and Radkowski, Numerical Analysis of Unsymmetrical Bending of Shells of Revolution, AIAA J 1(8):1833-1842, Aug 1963, DOI 10.2514/3.1932. No open copy exists: OpenAlex lists it closed with no repository full text, NASA NTRS has no record, and no DTIC report was found. Two NASA documents, both marked government public use permitted, carry its method. They are staged with a README and SHA256SUMS at unpublished-local-ref:fd987d5ef602cedd. (1) NASA CR-92024 (1967; Cappelli, Nishimoto, Pauley, Radkowski; NTRS 19680010398) states that it extends Budiansky and Radkowski, with notation identical to theirs except where noted: Fourier separation, meridional finite differences, direct matrix elimination. It adds transverse shear and dynamics, so it is a superset, not a copy. (2) NASA TN D-7337 (1973; Noor and Stephens; NTRS 19740005524) compares finite-difference schemes for shells of revolution, including the Budiansky-Radkowski second-order scheme, with numerical results on test problems; it may bear on the comparator-uncertainty gap. Neither file is the 1963 paper. Whether either serves under contract 2fb69f50, or the original is still needed, is Sciences' judgement through you. If the original is needed, the routes are an AIAA single-article purchase or a library loan, by his hand. Both files are public-use NASA documents, so the 1969 copy's provenance limits do not apply to them. No purchase, correspondence or spend.
